principal.deskTitle: Dedicated to foundational excellence and holistic child care
messageParagraphs: Established in 1988, Sisuvihar English Medium School has been a trusted educational institution for primary and foundational learning in Kilimanoor. We are committed to nurturing each child's innate curiosity in a secure, supportive, and stimulating environment.

With active pre-primary sections and classes from 1 to 4, our dedicated team of experienced teachers fosters English language fluency, foundational mathematics, computer-aided learning, and essential social values from an early age.

about.tagline: Fostering early childhood education and primary excellence in Kilimanoor since 1988
about.leadText: Sisuvihar English Medium School was founded in 1988 to provide structured English-medium foundational schooling to children in Kilimanoor and neighboring areas of Thiruvananthapuram. As a private unaided co-educational school, we offer personalized attention across pre-primary and primary grades (Classes 1 to 4).
about.secondaryText: The campus features 10 instructional classrooms, functional computer-aided learning facilities, a dedicated library with 400 books, a secure playground, and safe drinking water facilities. Academic sessions run from April, welcoming children into a joyful, disciplined learning environment.
about.footerSnippet: Private Unaided Co-educational School (UDISE: 32140500314) in Kilimanoor Block, Thiruvananthapuram District, Kerala.
